Hm? Oops... I was lost  in thought...\nWell, it's about our hometown Elban...
The green town on the Eldenbaum with a constant\ngentle breeze...It's never left my mind since\nit was occupied...
Occupied by whom, you asked?\nEven King Elbano doesn't know,\nhow are we supposed to know?!
But it conquered the great Eldenbaum without\nbeing noticed by anyone. One thing for sure is\nit's not something humans can do...
Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.\nPlease check the bag and report again.
*yawn* It's so boring... Huh? Think about it.\nIt's the Resistle's city, El Scaro,\nyou know?
There's a strict check on the people going in\nand out, even Cule merchants don't try to get\ninto this city...
Originally, it used to be a facility to research\ndangerous magic, so the buildings are very tough\nand hard to sneak in.
It's not confidential that King Elbano is here,\nbut it's not widely announced.\nSo, we seldom get attacked...

Do we need to stand right here?!

We should be deployed at the gate or something,
right?!
...Well, being free means King Elbano is safe.\nMaybe I should stop complaining about it.
Zzz... Zzz... Zzz...
Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.\nPlease check the bag and report again.
Want to know more about Darkan? Very well.\nDarkan is a small kingdom but it has never\nbeen invaded by other great nations.
We, Darkan royal family has deep connections\nwith the 12 gods from the ancient times.
When there were 4 countries in this world and\na long-lasting conflict between the other\n3 countries,
Our ancestors were trying hard to stop the wars\nat the requests of the 12 gods...
Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.\nPlease check the bag and report again.
Y-You're...! ...Oh? Excuse me.\nI was surprised because you look like the person\nI know... What brings you here?
You told the King that you have overcome the\ntrial from Kurgon the chairman and were told\nto have an audience with him...
W-What the... I was really surprised to see that\nyou look like the one who saved Darkan and\nthe world as depicted in the royal documents.
It shouldn't be a mistake if Kurgon also felt\nsomething about you. You could be the descendant\nor reincarnation of the savior...
I would like to ask the soul of the savior inside\nyou for help. Please give us a hand again to\nregain Eldenbaum our motherland...
W-Wait... Could you?\nThis guy's... Oh, no.\nThis adventurer is not such a great...
You know, this adventurer didn't know anything\nabout this world including Darkan and Elden...\nbaum, right? How could he be a savior...
Is that so? Then, Ask me anything.\nYou might remember something while you're\nlistening to me.
About Darkan
About Eldenbaum
What happened during the Cataclysm?
What happened to Eldenbaum?
Who took Eldenbaum?
Quit
Darkan is an elven kingdom that existed before the\nCataclysm. People lost the land due to\nexcessive Goddess Beads mining, so they built
a civilization on Eldenbaum the great tree, which\nis Darkan Kingdom. After Eldenbaum was taken, the\nelves got separated but our kingdom was not lost.
It's an incredibly huge tree. When the land\nwas lost, our ancestors escaped to the tree and\ncreated artificial land to build towns...
Under Eldenbaum? There is a huge hole & Eldenbaum\nis clinging to the countless roots on the ground\naround it.
Where does the hole lead to, you asked?\nHmm, people say it leads to another world\nbut nobody confirmed it.
When the Cataclysm occurred, Darkan Kingdom was\nabout to get thrown out of this world but...
But it remained with Eldenbaum and landed on\nthe ground joined by the 12 gods.
Since then, Darkan and its surrounding prospered\non Eldenbaum, but...
A few years ago, unknown things suddenly appeared\nfrom the inside of Eldenbaum & occupied the city.
The ground around Eldenbaum sank at the same time\nand Eldenbaum got completely separated from\nthe ground and the world...
We barely escaped the invasion and collapse. We\nthen formed the Resistle faction and built\nEl Scaro that's protected with magic.
And we are researching magic, building magic\nbarrier facilities and fighting against\ninvaders to prepare for the ones who attacked
Eldenbaum in case they appear from other places.
I have no idea. We call them invaders.\nBut they are totally different from the monsters\noriginally in Eldenbaum. They're mysterious.
Maybe they got in from the underground of\nEldenbaum. If they are lurking underground,\nthey may appear in other places too.
How was it? Do you remember anything?\nI see. But I still believe that you're the\nreincarnation of the savior.
Please defeat the invaders and give us a hand\nto regain Eldenbaum. I beg of you on behalf of\nall the Darkan people...
What? ...I know you won't stop, will you?\nI can't just back out now.\nI'll go with you anywhere.
But remember, I'll escape when I feel I'm in\ndanger. If everything goes well, I'll ask for\na bunch of rewards, okay?
Oh, savior! I appreciate it!!\nFrom now on, you two will be treated as our\nhigh-class soldiers. Thank you!
W-Wait, wait. I'm just a merchant not a...

Your Majesty!
There was an explosion at the
Magic Waste Site!! The magnitude and the damage
caused by the explosion are yet to be confirmed.
What?! It happened at the worst time for you.\nI know this is too sudden, but...
...Hm, I grasped the situation but...\nI'm concerned about the black crystals found\namong the wastes.
I asked the researchers about them but they said\nthey didn't throw away such things...
Unknown materials were found in there, so\nit means someone has sneaked into the waste site.\nDid you see any suspicious persons?
Hmm, I see... Anyway, thanks for defeating the\nmonster in the incinerator.\nI've prepared a room at the inn. Have a nice rest.
Stop! It's the palace of Darkan King Elbano VII.\nHave you overcome the trial from Kurgon to have\nan audience with the King?
...Hmph, not yet?\nThen, you are not allowed to pass here.
Sometimes, you must follow the predetermined\nprocedures to proceed to the next step. It's no\nuse acting up here. We'll never let you pass.
Oh, you came at the right time...\nActually, we've got another problem...
Have you heard of the black knight? ...Ho!\nSo, you've met him before... Many people say that\nhe saved them when they were attacked by monsters.
But these days, the black knight is reported to\nhave robbed people of their money and goods\nmany times.
*sigh* I hear a lot about that sort of knight.\nThey act like a nice guy when they're well off.\nBut they turn into a bandit when they're hard up.
People say that the black knight was wearing a\nspiky and frightful armor. How about the black\nknight you've met?
Sounds like he's a different person...
Hey, isn't he the guy who was attacking wandering\nknights to lure the black knight out?
You have someone in mind?
You told King Elbano about Ruzart, who was\nattacking the knights and soldiers that wield\nan axe just to beat the black knight...
But it sounds different from the masked warrior\nhe disguised himself as...
Can't believe such an outrageous person is one of\nthe undercover agents...But, it doesn't mean he's\nthe black knight that has been attacking people...
I'd like to request you to defeat him to prevent\nfurther damage. Would you do that?
If he's the culprit again, it means he's desperate\nbecause he has been banished, right?...I can tell.\nI saw everything that happened to him...
Now that he's like a wounded beast, we never\nknow what he may do next. We can't leave him\nas he is, can we? Let's do it.
You'll do it?! Thanks in advance.
You turned Ruzart over to King Elbano and\nreported the details of the false black knight\nincident...
Evil deeds to innocent people for your stupid and\nselfish desires...You can't blame the black\ncrystal for what you've done! Idiot!! Take him!
The black crystal could be the main cause of the\nwaste site case and Ruzart's case this time.\nBut what is it...
I assume that it might have something to do with\nthe ones that invaded Eldenbaum...\nI might ask you to investigate it later...
Anyway, you've done well today.\nHave a nice rest.
...Hm? Oh, it's you. I just got an upsetting\nreport... Our soldiers went to the north east\nof Wanderers' Plains and got hit by magic bullets.
And it was a barrage of bullets and they\ncouldn't see who the enemy was... I'm sorry\nto ask you but could you get rid of them?
Hey, isn't it the black crystal that disappeared\nfrom the false black knight?
It's not really far from there, so it could be...
Oh, I'm relieved to see you're safe.\nSo, the enemy was the black crystal?\n...No?! The self-propelled golems of Technista?!
Hmm, it's much worse than the black crystal...\nIt must be the extremist Technista group,\n[ffff64]Lyark Technista[ffffff]...
Lyark? ...I think I've heard of it.\nTechnista is divided into Pax Technista and\nLyark Technista...
Right... Pax tries to use only safe technology\nfor the development of civilization.
On the contrary, Lyark uses all kinds of techs\nsuch as magic, science, & machine for their\nbenefits. We Resistle can't get along with them.
Not only that! The land subsidence that occurred\nto our Eldenbaum during its occupation turns out\nto be extremely similar
to the tectonism caused by the magic weapon called\nSimcracker that once existed in this world!
S-Sim Cracker...? W-What is it??
Simcracker is a weapon that was developed in\nSlebinian Empire, which is the origin of Technista\nIt converts Goddess Beads that are keeping
the ground of this world intact into energy\nat once and breaks the ground apart...Who else\ncan create such a horrible thing except them?!
What is worse!! We couldn't go to see the land\nthat survived the collapse because of\nthe monsters until now, however...
Through the investigation of our undercover\nagents, we found out that a high-tech mysterious\nEmpire is being established...
Advanced technology... No wonder...
The invasion of Eldenbaum... The land subsidence\nthat may have been caused by Simcracker, the\nmysterious Empire near the land...
And the self-propelled golems found around\nEl Scaro...everything seems like they're just\ntrying to get rid of the Resistle, but...
There must be more to their plan...
...I would like to ask you to sneak into the\nmysterious Empire and, if there is a weapon of\nmass destruction such as Simcracker,
Destroy it before it brings disaster to this world\nI can only count on a skilled adventurer like you\nto do this difficult task. Could you do that?
You won't stop, right?\nI'll go with you!\nBut promise I'll be highly rewarded.
I appreciate it. It will take long to reach\nEldenbaum, and it might be hard to get supplies\non your way. You should be prepared enough.
Well, since she's with you, there should be\nnothing to worry about.
Me? Y-Yes... L-Leave it to me.
Okay, now stock up supplies, get what you'll\nneed and let's go.
Oh, you've really come back!\nI got the report from the soldier who escorted\nPelulu to Lunagent Mountain but...
Right. Pelulu reported that an unknown monster\nkilled you and you disappeared soon after that.\nSo, I ordered the soldiers to search for you.
Pelulu said that you were killed, so the soldiers\nwere astounded to see that you were alive.\nBy the way, where were you?
He might not believe your story but you should\nreport the whole thing that has happened in the\nDark Realm.
You reported to King Elbano about the Dark Realm...
Oh my... Grecia the Goddess of Courage saved you\nwhen you almost died and you’ve been in the Dark\nRealm... That's totally beyond my understanding.
Hey... You're hiding something from the King and\nme, aren't ya?\nYou were saved by the Goddess, and...
You could go to the Dark Realm, the world of\nthe deceased. I don't think you're an ordinary\nhuman, are you?
You must be a descendant of a knight that was\ngiven some special power by gods, or you are a\nreincarnation of a famous mage, aren't ya?!
Pelulu doubts you're someone with some special\npower. You couldn't help laughing...
Hey!!\nYou can't just laugh this off!
The horrible monster at the Lunagent Mountain\nwas targeting you, right?!\nStop playing dumb and confess!!
Now now, Pelulu. Calm down...\nNo matter who this adventurer is, there was\na battle in the Dark Realm, so
it's clear that we can't avoid fighting the black\ncrystals that are threatening our world.
The monster that Pelulu was talking about may have\nsomething to do with the black crystals...
We need to find out what they are and what they\nare planning to do behind the scenes in this\nworld including the Dark Realm...
In addition to that, there's one more thing\nI want you to do.
Yes. The empire of Lyark Technista has been\ngetting more active while you were not around.
The weapons that appear to have been created in\nthe empire are posing threat not only to the\ntowns of Pax faction, but also to El Scaro...
Well, I can guess you're gonna ask...
Right. Though they keep sending out various\nweapons, the situation in the empire of Lyark\nTechnista remains unknown. So, I want you to
investigate it as well as the situation of the Pax\nfaction that is being threatened by the empire.\nMaybe we can cooperate with the Pax faction...
I knew this would happen when you came back.\nI'll go with you, so why not accept it?
But I'll leave you and run away if something like\nlast time happens again!
Alright! I'll leave it to you.\nYou may have to face many risky situations but\nremember to prioritize both of your lives.
I'm glad you came back safe.\nBy the way, a messenger came from Einklang before\nyou reach here.
The letter said Tnark the mayor wanted us to\njoin forces with them against the threat...
Tnark must have sent the letter while you were\ninvestigating the Lyark faction.
Your contribution was also written in the letter.
Helping people in crisis in Einklang while working\non the investigation is not something an ordinary\nadventurer could do...I really admire you.
Ha! You look happy!\nYou've gotta report many things, right?\nGo ahead.
You reported about Ultimea the imperial city-state\nof Lyark, Demi Machinas the humanoid weapons\ndeveloped by the state, the black knights,
the current situation in Einklang and Klaspe Slum,\nand not only the Pax faction, but also Diel's\nresistance against the tyranny of Lyark.
Ultimea the empire city-state of Lyark...\nFinally...
I've heard about the black knights before but\nDemi Machinas the monstrous weapons made of\nhumans are horrible.
Human bodies are more than just a thing!\nHow blasphemous!!
You asked him about he mysterious structure\nfound in Singolare Ruins too...
...A mysterious structure in Singolare Ruins?\nWhat does it look like?
Hey, do you have anything to write with?\n...Uh, that's good. Let me use it.
I remember it was like this...
Pelulu drew the mysterious structure in detail on\nthe paper.\nWho could imagine that she has such a talent...?
What? I'm a bit of a merchant, so it's a piece of\ncake to remember the characteristics of a thing.\nNow, show it to the King.
Hm, so this is the structure...\nUmm, it looks like some kind of machine.\nIt should be very old...
Isn't it the magic weapon that break the ground\napart?
You mean Simcracker? I've seen it only in a book.\nBut the shape is totally different. I've never seen\nsuch a thing, so I have no idea what it is.
Kurgon the chairman of the senate may know it.\nYou might want to go ask him.
CHALLENGE BATTLE\nDefeat Platinum Potum!!
You reported that the mysterious substance in the\nruins was Wizard Cannon the horrible magic weapon.
What in the... Such a fearful thing has been\nexcavated and restored... Who tried to use it...?
Seems like it's someone called Coenubia who\nrestored the Wizard Cannon.\nWe have no idea who he or she is though...
Well, we've destroyed the huge crysta factory, so\nthe Wizard Cannon can't be activated, right?
Right. You've prevented the disaster before it\noccurs. I appreciate it. However, there is a report\nthat indicates another crisis...
Travelers are frequently attacked near the border\nbetween the suburb of El Scaro and the land of\nPax Technista. Does it ring a bell?
Your Majesty, it could be the Demi Machinas that\nwe reported last time...
Demi Machinas?!\nThose blasphemous things!!
Lyark faction...\nI didn't expect them to approach El Scaro\nthis fast...
Then, we all people in El Scaro will cooperate\nwith the Pax faction and the partisans to\neliminate Demi Machinas the artificial monsters!!
I know you two have just come back here but I need\nyou to pin down the factory of Demi Machinas and\ndestroy it if possible. Could you do that?
Wait..."You two" means I'm included, right?\nHow could you say yes so easily!\nIt's pretty tough, you know?
Well, it's no use grumbling here.\nLet's tell Shreya that the King is asking the\npartisans for cooperation. Come on, right now!
You reported to the King that you have destroyed\nthe Demi Machina Factories...
Great job! You've blown the factories up!!
Now the threat of the artificial monsters has\nbeen removed but...
We can't just sit and watch the Lyark continues to\ndevelop weapons that are threats to world peace...
We need to attack Ultimea, which is supposed to\nbe the capital of the Empire of Lyark but...
We have no information about Ultimea.\nEven its existence is coming into question...
So, I want you to continue the investigation and\ncollect the information of Ultimea...
Huh? Of course, I'll go with you.\nI wanna know who Balft and Triel really are.
Who are you talking about?
Eh? Ah, no no. They're just my friends.\nHa ha... See you later!
After Venena escaped, El Scaro's army, the Lufenas\nand the partisans of Einklang gained total control\nof Ultimea and the Empire of Lyark collapsed...
...Hm, the troop of black knights were destroyed.\nDr. Brahe, the creator of Demi Machinas, was\neaten by monster and died.
So, the partisan allies took control of Ultimea\nafter Venena the empress escaped...
It should be officially recorded like this...
How emotionless. It tells nothing about the blood\n& tears shed during the war...How can people know\nwhat happened to the partisans in Hora Diomedea.
...I agree. This record lacks humanity...\nBut the official records have to describe facts.\nIt cannot be dramatic nor emotional...
I know... And it wasn't your majesty who wrote it.\nI was wrong to blame you for it.
I'm sorry...
It's alright. I know how you feel...A minstrel\nwould have composed a poem and recited exactly\nhow well the partisans fought to admire them...
Rather than a dull report like this,\nI would prefer to hear that one too...
Anyway, you have gone through a lot of fierce\nbattles. Take a good rest first, and I'd like\nto ask you to investigate Eldenbaum...
There was no way you can go to Eldenbaum from\nUltimea...
Yes. There is a way from Tolbas Grassland\nwhich lies ahead of Einklang but...
According to the recent reports, it's occupied by\nsomething... Perhaps, it's Coenubia...
So, we don't know what is happening there.\nI ordered the soldiers to find another\nroute though...
If I remember correctly, there is an old mine\nahead of the grassland. I heard about it from\nsomeone long ago...
Maybe we can go to Eldenbaum from there.
The reports said the mine is also being occupied\nby monsters... Our soldiers are dealing with them\nbut the situation seems difficult...
Ha ha... I knew you would say so...\nBut stay alert on your way. The investigation of\nEldenbaum... I'm counting on you!
Ooh, you're back! I got a request from Kunon the\nGoddess of Justice to send some reinforcements to\nrecapture Eldenbaum earlier.
Seems like you sent the person who was with you to\nreport to me when you were going towards\nEldenbaum.
You told him about the big hole on the ground that\nprevented you from going to Eldenbaum from Elf\nMountains...
Umm...I see. I guess you can only go from the\nstreet ahead of Tolbas...
However, it's been inaccessible since it's being\nblocked by monsters that seemed to be controlled\nby Coenubia...
Besides getting rid of them, we also need to\nensure that it is safe for the troops to pass to\nreach Eldenbaum.
So, I would like to form a special vanguard.\nBut I need your cooperation too...
Pelulu, are you okay with it?\nI thought you hate getting yourself into trouble,\nno?
Well, given the circumstances, if I say no this\ntime, I'm not human. Anyway, I can just run away\nwhen it gets dangerous!
Hahhahha! You've grown up! Good, good!!\nI'm thankful. All right, just go get some rest for\nnow while I pick the right members...
Sorry to have kept you waiting, the vanguard is\nformed. The soldiers are getting ready and will\nbe here in no time...
Garrador Berenin, captain of Eldenbaum's vanguard,\nbow to King Elbano!
Laureraz Deneorn, vice-captain of Eldenbaum's\nvanguard, also bow to King Elbano...
Chief Sapper Gondrum Solon along with all 12\nchosen soldiers, also bow to King Elbano!
Good! Thanks for accepting this dangerous duty!!\nIt's no exaggeration to say that the success of\nrecapturing Eldenbaum depends on you...
Let me introduce the people who will go to\nEldenbaum with you and back you up.
Both of them are Straye adventurers that have gone\nthrough many adventures and know quite a lot about\nthe things occupying Eldenbaum!
Here are the personnel of Eldenbaum's vanguard.\nThey're all elite soldiers, and with your help,
I believe getting to Eldenbaum won't be a problem.\nPlease get along...
Nice to meet you.
I've heard so much about you from King Elbano.\nI think we might trouble you to back us up...
Yo! Straye fellas!\nI'm Gondrum, the chief sapper...
I set up our base and camp. Nice to meet you.\nI heard you're pretty good, huh?
But honestly, this lady over here doesn't seem so.
Oh, I'm sorry if I don't look strong to you!\nBecause originally I'm a merchant, you know!
However, this hammer has been through hell quite\nmany times and I'm afraid it might hurt a guy with\na shallow mind now.
Oh! I'm scared! Just joking, I know you're good\nand I respect you, really! We need you to back us\nup till we reach Eldenbaum!!
What was that...? I can't believe there's such an\nignorant Elf like him...
I'm sorry if he was being rude. It's just Gondrum\nbeing Gondrum, please forgive him...By the way,
it's not that I suspect what King Elbano said, but\nit's just my stupid personality that I only\nbelieve in what I see...
Oh, noo, I hate that!
Hahaha, of course! I know we just met and this\nmight be kinda rude, but...
this is simply because as the captain, I'm\nresponsible for the soldiers' lives and I'm\nleading us to recapture Eldenbaum...
You're right...Okay, we'll show you what we're\nmade of along the way to Eldenbaum. What do you\nsay?
Fair enough...I can't wait to see your skills with\nmy own eyes...
It's okay to compete against each other, but just\nmake sure you don't fight each other...
By the way, once you make it to Eldenbaum, I want\nyou to set up an outpost to be ready for the\nbattle to recapture it. An ideal place would be...
Where would it be?
Dikkit Sector...That place is stocked with various\ngoods and would be a perfect depot to be prepared\nfor the worst.
So once you reach Eldenbaum, just aim for it.
Understood! All right troops, let’s set out for\nDikkit District in Eldenbaum right now!!
You can move to [ffff64]Dikkit Sector[ffffff] with\nthe teleporter that has been activated.\nUse teleporter?
Teleport to [ffff64]Dikkit Sector[ffffff]!!
Quit
After saying goodbye to Dunkelis and the others,\nyou return to El Scaro...
You reported to King Elbano about the collision\nbetween this world and Toram, a world where\nCoenubias lived, that caused the Cataclysm...
You also told him that Coenubia is a life form\ncoming from Toram and the main creatures have\nreturned there to heal their injuries...
Hmm...that was like a lot of extremely unusual\nstories. I guess it will take me a while to\nunderstand and believe all those...
But, there's no doubt about Coenubia's stronghold\nbeing in the world called Toram that the Coenubia\nleader mentioned at the time of the battle...
The problem now is how do we get there...
Reporting to King Elbano!\nA messenger just delivered a letter from\nPresident Kunon of Nov Saterica!
Huh? A letter? This...
Oh...Since Kunon is the Goddess of Justice,\nshe seems to have figured out the problem we are\nfacing...
She would like to talk about how to get to Toram.\nGo see her immediately!
I'm counting on you...\nOh yeah, perhaps you'll head to Toram directly,\nso just in case, let them go with you...
Ohh! We met in Scaro Town a long time ago...
Tee-hee, I'm glad you remember!
She's a high-ranked mage and because of that she\nwas assigned to guard Scaro Town.
Wowww, we'll feel safe if someone as amazing as\nyou are coming to Toram with us, right?
Fine! Your journey to Toram may not be smooth,\nplease be very careful!
